goals.title: 문서 단계 1-4: 원본 구조 이식과 표면 검증
goals.objective: docs/original_first_tutorial_plan.md의 1-4단계를 app/data/web/test 산출물로 완성한다: <original_app_root> 기준 FastAPI 구조, RAG 서비스 구조, 관광 상담 서비스, 전국 지역 데이터, /tourism-ui/ 웹 화면, 실행 스크립트, 평가/캐시/로그/회귀 테스트 흐름을 project_template에 재현하고, 비밀값과 런타임 부산물은 제외하며, 테스트와 실제 HTTP/browser QA 증거로 검증한다.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP call: start `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765` from `project_template`, then run `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:8765/health` and `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:8765/tourism/regions`. PASS iff health is HTTP/1.1 200 with {"status":"ok"}, regions is HTTP/1.1 200, has 17 areas, and 서울/부산/인천 중구 disambiguation exists. Automated RED→GREEN: `python -m pytest tests/test_project_template_parity.py::test_project_template_health_and_regions_surface`.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/C001-http-health-regions.txt with failing pytest output before implementation, passing pytest output after implementation, curl status+headers+body, and cleanup receipt for uvicorn PID/port.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/C001-http-health-regions.txt | cleanup: killed uvicorn PID, removed tmp files/pycache/vector_store/chroma, port8765 none

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP call: start `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8766` from `project_template`, then run `curl -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8766/tourism/chat -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "{\"message\":\"   \"}"`. PASS iff HTTP status is 400, body says `message는 비어 있을 수 없습니다.`, and no internal terms Chroma/top_k/lookup_mode/fallback/debug/pipeline/parity appear. Automated RED→GREEN: `python -m pytest tests/test_project_template_parity.py::test_project_template_tourism_chat_rejects_blank_without_internal_terms`.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/C002-http-blank-chat.txt with RED→GREEN pytest output, curl artifact, and cleanup receipt.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use: start `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8767` from `project_template`, open `http://127.0.0.1:8767/tourism-ui/` in real browser automation, assert option UI controls exist (`#chatModeButton`, `#optionModeButton`, `#optionDrawer`, `#optionSigungu`) and visible page text does not include RAG 질문/FastAPI tutorial result/Chroma 관광 근거 검색/top_k/lookup_mode/fallback/debug/pipeline/parity. Automated RED→GREEN: `python -m pytest tests/test_project_template_parity.py::test_project_template_web_ui_contract_and_no_user_internal_terms`.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/C003-browser-ui.png plus action log text with RED→GREEN pytest output and cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/C003-browser-ui.txt and .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/C003-browser-ui.png | cleanup: playwright close session ulw-c003, killed uvicorn PID, removed .playwright-cli/tmp/pycache/vector_store/chroma, port8767 none

goals.title: 원본 기준 문서화와 초급자 튜토리얼 완성
goals.objective: docs/original_first_tutorial_plan.md의 1단계와 5단계까지 완성한다: 원본 앱 파일 맵, 복사 금지 대상, 목표 구조 비교표를 문서화하고, 초급자가 project_template 원본형 앱을 만들 수 있도록 장별 튜토리얼을 작성한다. 각 장은 왜 필요한가, 만들 파일, 코드 흐름, 실행 명령, 확인 기준, 자주 나는 오류를 포함한다. 웹/API 산출물은 튜토리얼 표현 없이 사용자용 앱으로 유지한다.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI stdout channel: run `python3 scripts/validate_tutorial_docs.py --check original-map`. PASS iff command exits 0 and prints `original-map: ok`. Automated RED→GREEN: `python -m pytest tests/test_tutorial_docs.py::test_original_file_map_and_copy_policy_documented`.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/G002-C001-doc-map.txt with RED→GREEN pytest output, CLI stdout transcript, cleanup receipt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/019eb545-00c9-7263-9fe4-88e6178e57e3/evidence/G002-C001-doc-map.txt | cleanup: no spawned process, no temp files, no ports
